ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 70% high-intensity (white) to 30% low-intensity (black/dark-grey) distribution across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous white areas dominate the central lobes; high-contrast black pigmentation is concentrated in a jagged band along the trailing edge, around the median notch, and as distinct linear streaks on the left lobe surface.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with a calculated pixel angle of approximately 92 degrees and a depth equivalent to ~12% of the total lobe span.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency serration along the entire trailing edge boundary; pixel-amplitude of peaks varies between 3-10 pixels, creating a continuous irregular sawtooth profile.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature on the leading edge with a tapering concavity toward the distal tips along the trailing edge.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Small, dark, roughly circular pixel clusters localized at the distal tips of both lobes and sporadically along the trailing edge serrations.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple dark, unaligned linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) observed primarily on the left lobe, oriented diagonally to the trailing edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Multiple parallel linear rake marks on the left ventral surface; irregular jagged indentations on the trailing edge consistent with physical trauma.
